channel.title: Tech Unzip
channel.description: A 30-minute daily tech briefing for your walk, commute or school run. Hosts Ryan and Heart cover the day's biggest stories in AI, big data, chips, e-commerce and product design, then unzip them: what to remember, how it changes society and work, and one concept explained simply. New every weekday, never repeating what you've already heard.
